QuestInfo.name: [Battle Mode] Grand Battle Grand Opening!
QuestInfo.0: Haktorius recommended that you go to the Elite Guardian Training Institute.
QuestInfo.1: Speak with Haktorius at the Battle Square right away.\nUse the #e#bDimensional Mirror#k#n to get to the Battle Squaer.
QuestInfo.2: You must become strong to protect Maple World from the Black Mage. Participate in Battle Mode and get your battle on!

0.0: You stand before Haktorius, greatest of all trainers! \r\nTell me little warrior, will you fight for the peace of Maple World?\r\n

yes.0: The Black Mage is back, but he must have a herniated disc or something because he's not really moving around much. Take the #e#bDimensional Mirror#k#n to the #r#eBattle Square#k#n and help us fight off his goons!

no.0: Don't ever think that one person won't make the difference. If I went in there, this whole thing would be over in minutes!

1.0: I'm glad you're on our side. Now that Mr. World Domination is back, we're going to need all the help we can get. We've got one month to complete this #b#eGrand Battle#k#n. That means we've got until #eTKTKTK#n. It's going to take everything we can muster to win this one.\r\n
